Encrypt with a public key

Everything is processed locally in your browser. Your public key and message are never sent over the network.

  • Key format:
    • SPKI defines a standard format for storing public keys.
    • PEM is a file format for storing cryptographic keys and certificates.
  • Encryption scheme:
    • ECDH-HKDF-AES-256-GCM: use Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman with a Hash-based Key Derivation Function and AES-256-GCM encryption.
    • RSA-OAEP-AES-256-GCM: use Rivest–Shamir–Adleman (RSA) with Optimal Asymmetric Encryption Padding (OAEP) and AES-256-GCM encryption.
More information: Public key encryption / decryption
